capabilities: Sync financial data from the Alfonso Money Manager app to the vault
Query financial data with the Alfonso Query Language (AQL)
Render charts from query results with ApexCharts
Convert currencies using daily exchange rates
disambiguation: Not a standalone expense tracker; it only displays and analyzes data from the Alfonso Money Manager app.
extras: Detailed AQL and settings documentation lives on an external site rather than in the README. The plugin fetches currency exchange rates from an external API, updated once daily.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view or analyze data from the Alfonso Money Manager app inside the vault.

relations.evidence: synchronized with an Obsidian vault, allowing for enhanced data visualization and analysis
Utilize the Alfonso Query Language (AQL) to extract precise information and generate reports

summary: Companion plugin that syncs Alfonso Money Manager financial data into a vault and lets users query and chart it with AQL and ApexCharts.
